guidance.label: Guidance
guidance.source: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim (also cited in Riyāḍ aṣ-Ṣāliḥīn 1473); taught by the Prophet ﷺ to ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib

you_m.translation: O Allah, guide you and make you steadfast.

you_f.translation: O Allah, guide you and make you steadfast.

you_pl.translation: O Allah, guide you all and make you all steadfast.

me.translation: O Allah, guide me and make me steadfast.

us.translation: O Allah, guide us and make us steadfast.

him.translation: O Allah, guide him and make him steadfast.

her.translation: O Allah, guide her and make her steadfast.

them.translation: O Allah, guide them and make them steadfast.

you_m.arabic: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيَك
you_m.transliteration: As'alu Allāha al-'Aẓīma Rabbal-'Arshil-'Aẓīmi an yashfiyak.
you_m.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you.

you_f.arabic: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيَكِ
you_f.transliteration: As'alu Allāha al-'Aẓīma Rabbal-'Arshil-'Aẓīmi an yashfiyaki.
you_f.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you.

you_pl.arabic: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيَكم
you_pl.transliteration: As'alu Allāha al-'Aẓīma Rabbal-'Arshil-'Aẓīmi an yashfiyakum.
you_pl.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you all.

me.arabic: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيَني
me.transliteration: As'alu Allāha al-'Aẓīma Rabbal-'Arshil-'Aẓīmi an yashfiyanī.
me.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal me.

us.arabic: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيَنا
us.transliteration: As'alu Allāha al-'Aẓīma Rabbal-'Arshil-'Aẓīmi an yashfiyanā.
us.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal us.

him.arabic: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيَه
him.transliteration: As'alu Allāha al-'Aẓīma Rabbal-'Arshil-'Aẓīmi an yashfiyah.
him.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal him.

her.arabic: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيَها
her.transliteration: As'alu Allāha al-'Aẓīma Rabbal-'Arshil-'Aẓīmi an yashfiyahā.
her.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal her.

them.arabic: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيَهم
them.transliteration: As'alu Allāha al-'Aẓīma Rabbal-'Arshil-'Aẓīmi an yashfiyahum.
them.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal them.

ease.label: Ease
ease.source: Ibn Ḥibbān 2427 (graded ṣaḥīḥ by Ibn Ḥajar)

text.arabic: اللهم لا سهل إلا ما جعلته سهلاً، وأنت تجعل الحزن إذا شئت سهلاً
text.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā ja'altahu sahlā, wa anta taj'alul-ḥazna idhā shi'ta sahlā.
text.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make sorrow easy if You will.

text.arabic: اللهم إني أسألك من الخير كله، عاجله وآجله، ما علمت منه وما لم أعلم
text.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka minal-khayri kullih, 'ājilihi wa ājilih, mā 'alimtu minhu wa mā lam a'lam.
text.translation: O Allah, I ask You for all good, near and distant, what I know of it and what I don't.

protection.label: Protection
protection.source: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 3371; the Prophet ﷺ would seek refuge for al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn with these words

you_m.arabic: أعيذك بكلمات الله التامة من كل شيطان وهامة، ومن كل عين لامة
you_m.transliteration: Uʿīdhuka bi-kalimātillāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭāninwa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.
you_m.translation: I seek refuge for you in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

you_f.arabic: أعيذكِ بكلمات الله التامة من كل شيطان وهامة، ومن كل عين لامة
you_f.transliteration: Uʿīdhuki bi-kalimātillāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭāninwa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.
you_f.translation: I seek refuge for you in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

you_pl.arabic: أعيذكم بكلمات الله التامة من كل شيطان وهامة، ومن كل عين لامة
you_pl.transliteration: Uʿīdhukum bi-kalimātillāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭāninwa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.
you_pl.translation: I seek refuge for you all in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

me.arabic: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامة من كل شيطان وهامة، ومن كل عين لامة
me.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-kalimātillāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭāninwa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.
me.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

us.arabic: نعوذ بكلمات الله التامة من كل شيطان وهامة، ومن كل عين لامة
us.transliteration: Naʿūdhu bi-kalimātillāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭāninwa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.
us.translation: We seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

him.arabic: أعيذه بكلمات الله التامة من كل شيطان وهامة، ومن كل عين لامة
him.transliteration: Uʿīdhuhu bi-kalimātillāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭāninwa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.
him.translation: I seek refuge for him in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

her.arabic: أعيذها بكلمات الله التامة من كل شيطان وهامة، ومن كل عين لامة
her.transliteration: Uʿīdhuhā bi-kalimātillāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭāninwa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.
her.translation: I seek refuge for her in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

them.arabic: أعيذهم بكلمات الله التامة من كل شيطان وهامة، ومن كل عين لامة
them.transliteration: Uʿīdhuhum bi-kalimātillāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭāninwa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.
them.translation: I seek refuge for them in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

patience.label: Patience
patience.source: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 918; the Prophet ﷺ taught this to Umm Salamah upon calamity

you_m.arabic: اللهم أجرك في مصيبتك واخلف لك خيراً منها
you_m.transliteration: Allāhumma ajuraka fī muṣībatika wakhluf laka khayran minhā.
you_m.translation: O Allah, reward you for your affliction and replace it for you with something better.

you_f.arabic: اللهم أجركِ في مصيبتكِ واخلف لكِ خيراً منها
you_f.transliteration: Allāhumma ajuraki fī muṣībatiki wakhluf laki khayran minhā.
you_f.translation: O Allah, reward you for your affliction and replace it for you with something better.

you_pl.arabic: اللهم أجركم في مصيبتكم واخلف لكم خيراً منها
you_pl.transliteration: Allāhumma ajurakum fī muṣībatikum wakhluf lakum khayran minhā.
you_pl.translation: O Allah, reward you all for your affliction and replace it for you with something better.

me.arabic: اللهم أجرني في مصيبتي واخلف لي خيراً منها
me.transliteration: Allāhumma-jurnī fī muṣībatī wakhluf lī khayran minhā.
me.translation: O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

us.arabic: اللهم أجرنا في مصيبتنا واخلف لنا خيراً منها
us.transliteration: Allāhumma ajurnā fī muṣībatinā wakhluf lanā khayran minhā.
us.translation: O Allah, reward us for our affliction and replace it for us with something better.

him.arabic: اللهم أجره في مصيبته واخلف له خيراً منها
him.transliteration: Allāhumma ajurhu fī muṣībatihi wakhluf lahu khayran minhā.
him.translation: O Allah, reward him for his affliction and replace it for him with something better.

her.arabic: اللهم أجرها في مصيبتها واخلف لها خيراً منها
her.transliteration: Allāhumma ajurhā fī muṣībatihā wakhluf lahā khayran minhā.
her.translation: O Allah, reward her for her affliction and replace it for her with something better.

them.arabic: اللهم أجرهم في مصيبتهم واخلف لهم خيراً منها
them.transliteration: Allāhumma ajurhum fī muṣībatihim wakhluf lahum khayran minhā.
them.translation: O Allah, reward them for their affliction and replace it for them with something better.

forgiveness.label: Forgiveness
forgiveness.source: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6306 (agreed upon; from the Prophet's ﷺ duʿāʾ in rukūʿ and sujūd)

mercy.label: Mercy
mercy.source: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6224; the Prophet's ﷺ instruction for replying to someone who sneezes and praises Allah

you_m.translation: May Allah have mercy on you.

you_f.translation: May Allah have mercy on you.

you_pl.translation: May Allah have mercy on you all.

me.translation: May Allah have mercy on me.

us.translation: May Allah have mercy on us.

him.translation: May Allah have mercy on him.

her.translation: May Allah have mercy on her.

them.translation: May Allah have mercy on them.

you_m.translation: May Allah reward you with good.

you_f.translation: May Allah reward you with good.

you_pl.translation: May Allah reward you all with good.

me.translation: May Allah reward me with good.

us.translation: May Allah reward us with good.

him.translation: May Allah reward him with good.

her.translation: May Allah reward her with good.

them.translation: May Allah reward them with good.

knowledge.label: Knowledge
knowledge.source: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 143; the Prophet's ﷺ duʿāʾ for Ibn ʿAbbās

you_m.translation: O Allah, grant you understanding of the religion.

you_f.translation: O Allah, grant you understanding of the religion.

you_pl.translation: O Allah, grant you all understanding of the religion.

me.translation: O Allah, grant me understanding of the religion.

us.translation: O Allah, grant us understanding of the religion.

him.translation: O Allah, grant him understanding of the religion.

her.translation: O Allah, grant her understanding of the religion.

them.translation: O Allah, grant them understanding of the religion.

text.arabic: اللهم اكفني بحلالك عن حرامك، وأغنني بفضلك عمن سواك
text.transliteration: Allāhumm-akfinī bi-ḥalālika 'an ḥarāmik, wa aghninī bi-faḍlika 'amman siwāk.
text.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful, keeping me from what You have made unlawful, and enrich me by Your favor from all besides You.

text.arabic: بارك الله لكما وبارك عليكما وجمع بينكما في خير
text.transliteration: Bāraka Allāhu lakumā wa bāraka 'alaykumā wa jama'a baynakumā fī khayr.
text.translation: May Allah bless you both and unite you in goodness.

text.arabic: اللهم إنا نسألك في سفرنا هذا البر والتقوى، ومن العمل ما ترضى
text.transliteration: Allāhumma innā nas'aluka fī safarinā hādhal-birra wat-taqwā, wa minal-'amali mā tarḍā.
text.translation: O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and piety in this journey, and deeds that please You.

text.arabic: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري
text.transliteration: Rabbi-shraḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī
text.translation: My Lord, expand my chest for me and ease my task for me.

work.label: Work
work.source: Ibn Ḥibbān 2427 (graded ṣaḥīḥ by Ibn Ḥajar)

text.arabic: اللهم لا سهل إلا ما جعلته سهلاً، وأنت تجعل الحزن إذا شئت سهلاً
text.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā ja'altahu sahlā, wa anta taj'alul-ḥazna idhā shi'ta sahlā.
text.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make sorrow easy if You will.
